name: codex-delegate
description: Delegate implementation or research to Codex CLI in a Herdr pane, then verify the result and resume after usage limits.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate work to Codex CLI in a Herdr pane and verify the result.
interface.longDescription: Start Codex CLI in a sibling Herdr pane, hand it a task file, wait without polling, judge completion from a report file and a re-run of its checks, resume after usage limits, and close the pane when the work is done.
